commands.result: two isolated full-gate cycles and MCP contract smoke passed

commands.command:
mcp_contract_dist=$(mktemp -d /tmp/gpt-tunnel-gateway-mcp-contract-dist.XXXXXX)
bash scripts/build-release.sh "$mcp_contract_dist"
(cd "$mcp_contract_dist" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS && ! grep -Eq '  /' SHA256SUMS && test "$(./gpt-tunnel-gatewayd --version)" = 0.2.2 && test "$(./gpt-tunnel version)" = 0.2.2 && test "$(./gpt-tunnelctl version)" = 0.2.2)
commands.result: release checksums and all versions passed
